TEMPORARY ALIAS

Research Assistant:
When you do the Share Intel action, you may give any 1 City card.
When others Share Intel with you, they may take any 1 City card from you.

Cover
When playing with a temporary alias, for every cover you would scratch, discard 1 card (if you have any) instead.

TEMPORARY ALIAS

Medical Conference Coordinator:
As an action, you may move a team or a different player's pawn up to 3 cities away from its current city.
(The team/pawn does not enter any cities in between.)

Cover
When playing with a temporary alias, for every cover you would scratch, discard 1 card (if you have any) instead.

TEMPORARY ALIAS

Hospital Administrator:
You may do the Assemble Team action with one fewer card.

Cover
When playing with a temporary alias, for every cover you would scratch, discard 1 card (if you have any) instead.

TEMPORARY ALIAS

Clinic Planner:
When you do the Build Safehouse action, you do not need a City card.
As an action, while at a safehouse, discard a City card to move to any city on the board.

Cover
When playing with a temporary alias, for every cover you would scratch, discard 1 card (if you have any) instead.

SHOP OWNER As an action, while in the Shop Owner's city, swap 2 City cards from your hand with 1 City card from the Player discard pile.
CITY:

CRIME BOSS Once per turn, as an action, remove 1 agent from the Crime Boss's city or a city adjacent to it.
CITY:

POLITICIAN Once per turn, as an action, while in the Politician's city, you may give a City card to a player in any city.
CITY:
FOLLOWED: If you end your turn in a Soviet city, without an agent, add an agent to that city.
HASSLED: If you end your turn in a Soviet city, without a safe house, discard 1 card (after the Draw Cards step).
AUTHORITIES WATCHING: You may not do the Neutralize Agent action while in a city with an Incident token.
MONITORED: If you draw 2 Soviet City cards at the end of your turn, lose 1 cover.
AIRPORTS ALERTED: You may not do the Unrecorded Flight action from a Soviet city.
